description:
Quality finding from review: `cd apps/jido_connect_hubspot && mix test --no-deps-check` passes, but emits warnings. Observed warnings: duplicated function clauses in trigger test mock modules (`list_contacts/2` and `list_deals/2` clauses not grouped), and an unused default argument in `privacy_audit_test.exs` (`defp action(..., opts \\ [])` where every call supplies opts).

Why this matters: warnings are not harmless in this repo because the release posture is trending toward warnings-as-errors. Passing tests with warnings leave the package in a state where local package tests pass but stricter CI/release checks fail. The warnings also indicate generated tests were mechanically assembled without following idiomatic Elixir grouping rules.

Acceptance:
- Group same-name/same-arity mock clauses in HubSpot trigger tests so compiler warnings disappear.
- Remove the unused default argument from the privacy audit helper or add a legitimate zero-options call if that is clearer.
- `cd apps/jido_connect_hubspot && mix test --no-deps-check` passes with no warnings.
- Do not change HubSpot runtime behavior unless necessary for the tests.
title: [REVIEW-S06] Remove HubSpot generated-test warnings
